_comment: Themed circuits (v3_content_plan PART A + v6_party_gimmicks_circuits.md). Curated arena rotations with a difficulty arc. Level ids resolve to res://levels/<id>.json. Two rotation shapes: (1) ORDERED loop -- a plain `levels` array (string ids), played in authored order, looping (the shipped format). (2) RANDOM DRAW -- an optional `pool` array of {id, tier} + `draw_count` + `draw_mode`:'shuffle': each play SHUFFLES the pool, takes draw_count, and tier-sorts the drawn slice mild->wild (~20 authored / ~10 drawn per play, v6 3.2/3.3). `tier` (1-3) is the within-circuit wildness rank used only to order the drawn subset. Top-level `order` is the UNLOCK chain (v6 4.2): circuit N+1 unlocks when N is WON or played 3x (Settings progression).

meadow_mile.tagline: Sunny floating hills. The place to learn the bounce.
meadow_mile._comment: 20-arena ordered on-ramp (brawl_arena_expansion_2026-07-19.md). 4 originals + 16 new grass floating-island arenas in a mild->wild curated arc; a first-to-10 session (~10-15 rounds) never repeats.

scrapworks.tagline: Bumpers, drums, then the first hammers. Watch your step.
scrapworks._comment: 20-arena ordered industrial arc (brawl_arena_expansion_2026-07-19.md): hazards introduced one family at a time (bumper -> drum -> non-lethal swing -> first lethal hammer/crusher -> carts).

high_wire.tagline: Thin ridges and tall spires. The fall is the danger.
high_wire._comment: 18-arena ordered exposure arc (brawl_arena_expansion_2026-07-19.md): ridges/spires/radial/vertical, hazard-light — the fall is the danger. Capped at 18 (geometry-only variety saturates).

the_foundry.tagline: Presses, molten pours and floors that crack.
the_foundry._comment: Molten-factory gimmick circuit — grown to 16 arenas (brawl_arena_expansion_2026-07-19.md): presses/crushers, destructibles/debris, spinning hammers, and 3 collapsing-arena finales. Each match shuffles + draws 12, tier-sorted mild->wild, so a session rarely repeats and gets a fresh set. Unlock chain: win high_wire OR the pity path.

mayhem_mile.tagline: Mines, gravity wells, carts. Everything at once.
mayhem_mile._comment: The WILD gimmick-BRAWL circuit — now 20 DEDICATED arenas (brawl_arena_expansion_2026-07-19.md): stopped borrowing wrecking_yard/bumper_gauntlet/drop_chamber/islands_void (owned by scrapworks/meadow now); added 12 new (mines, gravity wells, carts, multi-hazard, collapse finale). Each play shuffles + draws 14 tier-sorted mild->wild, so a session doesn't repeat and every match is a fresh escalating set.
